method: Read all five complete Chinese essays and the previous English bodies, translate all 310 source units, then reread the saved boundary claims and inspect paragraph/strong/link correspondence. Counts are only structural checks.

findings: Replaced the independent English reconstruction with all 63 source paragraphs. Removed added friendship/neutrality arguments; restored category analysis, practical rebuilding, symmetrical precision test, meeting example, fallible mutual review and exact naming evidence.
anchors: Both friends and truth remain dear; honoring truth is duty, not a ranking of affection.
Subject-nature precision differs from the jurisdiction of this particular judgment; neither is arbitrary.
Leaving jurisdiction does not make the statement false.
Mutual review detects omissions but grants no final guarantee.
Plato unnamed in I.6; Pythagoreans and Speusippus named approvingly; Plato praised in I.4.

findings: Restored 67 source paragraphs instead of the shorter independent reconstruction, including the two kinds of infinity, school/guest-list examples, descriptive rather than ethical status of local gains, stopping versus membership, and the addition argument.
anchors: Final grounding differs from the intrinsic worth of each intermediate good.
Aristotle postpones the boundary question; the essay does not declare his method incapable.
No endpoint is not no gain; local gain is not promoted to the highest good.
Ability to stop cannot settle who counts.
Adding the smallest good would defeat happiness if it were one item among others; this closes the finality/self-sufficiency argument.

findings: Restored the full 61-paragraph route: the two readings of Solon, descendants dilemma and next-chapter limit, stability argument, crafts examples, Priam distinction, two columns, reliability example and the missing life-level subject.
anchors: Aristotle rejects happiness beginning at death, not every reading of Solon.
Priam: not wretched does not mean blessed; recovery requires a long and complete time.
Temporal uncertainty and fallible recording are distinct reasons against finality.
Ending a life cannot close subsequent review.
SAE has entry addresses but no account here of gathering them into one life.

findings: Restored all 66 source units, especially the asymmetry of the initially posed puzzle, the two meanings of doing just things, non-repetitive sedimentation, and the restricted scope and diachronic gap of philosophical signing.
anchors: Already-is objection differs from not-yet-cannot objection.
Beginners can produce the first-layer deed by chance or instruction; habit is the road, not a vicious circle.
Sedimentation may follow a single genuine distinction; the analogy is not repetition.
Signing concerns philosophical judgments and philosophies, not universal ownership.
Immediate bearer of a judgment is explicit; ownership across a philosophy’s changes remains open.

findings: Replaced the old fourfold-audit misdescription and added clinical/management illustrations with the source’s complete 53-paragraph account. Restored Calypso/Helen/second-voyage material, the replaceable exclusion premise, late/not-late and dash examples, Book II/VI distinction, and type rather than deficiency judgment.
anchors: Four results concern entry forms, not four truth values.
Both-at-one-address is not inherently an error; only the branch accepting exclusion incurs further differentiation.
Neither-side/dash differs from a judgment of none.
No universal measure does not mean no particular boundary.
Practical directions versus entry forms is the essay’s comparison, not an accusation that SAE omitted a promised ethics.

corrections: EP02 school example: removed the added adjective good, retaining the source’s plain admission to school.
EP01 restored both sides of the mathematician/orator symmetry and the praise-only placement of names.
EP02 restored intrinsic intermediate goods, local gains as descriptive, and the closing addition argument.
EP03 distinguished the next-chapter descendants resolution from the argument in this chapter.
EP04 kept the posed and unposed halves of the circle separate; sedimentation does not require repetition.
EP05 restored all four entry forms, the replaceable exclusion premise and the difference of type, without inventing an SAE ethics.

Independent full reread of the five Chinese/new-English essays found no lost argument; EP02 paragraph 4 changed asks us to look at nothing to does not ask us to look at anything to avoid a misleading reading.
